item.title: Gaza flotilla activists allege abuse by Israeli forces while detained
item.description: The detainees say they were slapped, hit, humiliated and even subjected to sexual violence, but Israel's prison service says the allegations are false.

item.title: Trump is putting pressure on Cuba - why and to what end?
item.description: The US has warned that a peaceful agreement with Cuba is unlikely, Havana insists this is a "fraudulent case" designed to justify military intervention.

item.title: Iran steps up claim to control Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran publishes a map claiming "armed forces oversight" across more than 22,000 sq km of the waterway.

item.title: AI used to fake evidence that ended Korean actor's career, say police
item.description: Police are seeking an arrest warrant for a YouTuber who allegedly fabricated evidence to defame actor Kim Soo-hyun.

item.title: Rubio visits India to sell energy as Iran oil shock persists
item.description: The top US diplomat has made statements offering to support India’s energy needs - but should Delhi give in?

item.title: US government releases UFO sighting reports - 'Orbs swarming in all directions'
item.description: The Pentagon discloses scores of UFO files with reported sightings of spheres, discs and fireballs spanning nearly 80 years.
